stem: Which sentence expresses the main idea of paragraph 2?

options.label: F
options.text: Jean Chu and her family adopted Dusty, their pet cat, a few years ago.

options.label: G
options.text: Not long after he moved in, the family members started finding odd objects lying around.

options.label: H
options.text: One day they would find a glove and an unfamiliar towel.

options.label: J
